KO.headline: Barclays Maintains Overweight on Coca-Cola, Raises Price Target to $98
KFC Had Pepsi for Nearly 40 Years. Coca-Cola Stock Is Trending After Winning It Over
KO.summary: The Coca-Cola Company is trending Friday after KFC said Thursday that its U.S. restaurants will replace PepsiCo beverages next year.

KO.headline: Coca-Cola Deals Pepsi a Stinging Blow, Snatches KFC After Nearly 40 Years
KO.summary: Ending a 40-year deal, KFC replaces Pepsi with Coca-Cola at 3,600 U.S. locations as part of its "Kentucky Fried Comeback."

KO.headline: 'KFC Is Moving to Ditch Pepsi for Coke in Thousands of Restaurants' - WSJ Exclusive
Defensives Lead Sectors In Thursday Trading As Technology Trails
KO.summary: Seven sectors are higher and four are lower in Thursday’s regular session, with defensive sectors holding two of the top three positions. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with Health Care sitting well above the next group.

KO.headline: Citigroup Maintains Buy on Coca-Cola, Raises Price Target to $102
